description: Na₅AuSe₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.18 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.38 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form NaSe₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.06 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.46 Å. Au is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Au-Se bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.54 Å. There are twelve inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Se square pyramids. The Se-Se bond length is 2.37 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Au, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.38 Å. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.36 Å. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Au, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.36 Å. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Au, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.36 Å. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Au, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.36 Å. In the seventh Se site, Se is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Se atoms. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Se atoms. The Se-Se bond length is 2.37 Å. In the ninth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Se trigonal bipyramids. The Se-Se bond length is 2.37 Å. In the tenth Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Se atoms. In the eleventh Se site, Se is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Se atoms. In the twelfth Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Se atom.
